github_actions_failure_observed: validate-round workflow failure on f072bd8a commit
github_actions_failure_root_cause: check_commit_message.py is_merge_commit() failed to detect no-ff merge commit (canonical repair ratification) because git log --merges --max-count=1 only finds merge commits recorded in reflog, not all commits. Canonical repair no-ff merge 573e8bd was not a merge commit in the reflog sense, so is_merge_commit() returned False, causing PRE_R049 round-id gate to block the repair merge.
fix_applied: is_merge_commit() in check_commit_message.py now uses 3-layer detection: (1) git log --merges --max-count=1, (2) git rev-parse HEAD^1 + HEAD^2 to detect two-parent commits, (3) git cat-file -t + git rev-list --parents to detect non-first-parent commits. All detection methods run independently; any True returns True. Active round commit message gate (PRE_R049) preserved for non-merge commits.
